trips.title: Waterfalls, Castles
trips.description: Church Fenton to Llanrwst via Pistyll Rhaeadr — the tallest waterfall in England or Wales. Bala Lake Railway, Beaumaris Castle, the Llyn Peninsula, Swallow Falls, Aber Falls and Penrhyn Castle. Elderly-friendly throughout, all accessible. 512 miles in 3 days.

trips.title: Duomo, Como
trips.description: Four days from Milan — a strike-day squeezed in around the Duomo Fast-Track Pass, the Galleria and Brera, then a Lake Como day trip by train, ferry and hydrofoil, and a light Bergamo day before the evening flight home.
